method.scope: Calendar year 2025. Reconstructed from public HLTV Rating 3.0 annual player and event pages retrieved in 2026.
method.original_3_5: Official MVP/EVP recipients from data/2025/awards.json plus config/watchlist.json; only Vexite is added by the watchlist.
method.shared_4_x: All 151 eligible 2025 players from the 4.x replay; snowzin and snow share HLTV player ID 20171. The 3.5 gates are applied after pool construction.
method.screened: Each screened player remains below 20 high-tier maps even if every missing map between two teams is assigned to every member of the relevant HLTV match rosters. No score imputed.
method.bodyy: The HLTV 3DMAX-filtered annual overview covers 193 maps, equal to all 193 unrestricted 2025 maps. The unrestricted event list also reconciles to 193.
